arguments.command:
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout 300 python3 -c "
import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
import controller
raw = open('/workspace/tmp/request.json','rb').read()
t=time.time()
res = controller.run(raw)
print('elapsed %.2f' % (time.time()-t))
json.dump(res, open('/workspace/tmp/response.json','w'))
print(json.dumps(res)[:800])
"
